Unlock these with Subscription The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is looking to reduce the onboarding time for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) to as short as five days, SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said on Friday (November 20, 2026), speaking at the CII Financing Summit in Mumbai. Speaking about the developments and milestones achieved by the regulator and the Indian equity market, Mr. Pandey said SEBI’s core philosophy is driven by optimum regulation. He highlighted that SEBI will soon come up with a consultation paper to further simplify ease of investment for FPIs. SEBI is likely to consider the removal of some of the constraints pertaining specifically to India. “The next phase of reforms must enable our capital markets to finance a wider range of businesses, attract longer-term investments and remain resilient as they grow,” Mr. Pandey said. He underscored the simplification of access to capital and regulatory compliance as one of the top priorities to develop and deepen the capital markets. SEBI has initiated a comprehensive review of the Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements (ICDR) framework and is also reviewing the Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) framework. The regulator is also working towards frameworks to eliminate duplicate reporting, simplify compliance and reduce the regulatory burden on listed entities. “By simplifying procedures and reducing avoidable compliance burdens, we aim to attract a wider pool of international capital and improve financing opportunities for Indian businesses while maintaining investor safeguards,” Mr. Pandey said. In an effort to deepen the corporate bond market, SEBI has been working in collaboration with the Reserve Bank of India and the Ministry of Finance. The Ministry and the regulators are working towards a market-making framework, or a fixed-income channel framework. The framework is expected to widen bond distribution and issuer outreach programmes. It is also aimed at identifying and addressing challenges and barriers in bond financing, Mr. Pandey said. “Bond trading is happening in the secondary market. There is also a request for platforms in which secondary trading is happening. But we need to increase secondary trading, particularly when we have facilitated retail investors to take direct bonds. But until trading is developed and there is liquidity, there won’t be enough maturity. To promote secondary trading, we have a market-making framework. You will get to know about its contours. https://www.thehindu.com/business/market.body_zh: 订阅还可享受 Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinions 等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）正考虑将外国组合投资者（FPI）的开户流程缩短至最短5天。SEBI主席图欣·坎塔·潘迪周五（2026年11月20日）在孟买举行的CII融资峰会上表示了这一计划。潘迪先生谈及监管机构取得的进展和印度股票市场取得的里程碑时表示，SEBI的核心理念以实现最佳监管为重点。他强调，SEBI即将发布一份征求意见文件，进一步简化外国组合投资者的投资流程。SEBI可能考虑取消部分专门针对印度的限制。潘迪先生说：“下一阶段的改革必须使我们的资本市场能够为更广泛的企业提供融资、吸引更长期的投资，并在发展过程中保持韧性。”他强调，简化资本获取渠道和监管合规，是发展并深化资本市场的首要任务之一。SEBI已启动对《资本发行与披露要求》（ICDR）框架的全面审查，目前也在审查《上市义务与披露要求》（LODR）框架。该监管机构还在制定相关框架，以消除重复报告、简化合规流程，并减轻上市公司的监管负担。潘迪先生说：“通过简化程序和减少可避免的合规负担，我们旨在吸引更多国际资本，为印度企业扩大融资机会，同时继续维护投资者保障。”为深化公司债券市场，SEBI一直与印度储备银行和财政部合作。财政部和各监管机构正共同制定做市商框架，即固定收益渠道框架。潘迪先生说，该框架预计将扩大债券分销和发行人 outreach 计划。它还旨在识别并解决债券融资中的挑战和障碍。潘迪先生在活动现场对记者说：“债券交易正在二级市场进行。目前也有人要求建立开展二级交易的平台。但我们需要扩大二级交易，尤其是在我们已帮助零售投资者直接购买债券的情况下。然而，在交易尚未发展、流动性不足之前，就不会形成足够的到期期限。为促进二级交易，我们正在制定做市商框架。届时大家会了解到其具体框架。这一工作仍在推进中。”评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性或针对个人的内容。发布评论时，请遵守我们的社区准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果您已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们文章的互动。如果您没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的Vuukle账户后，可以查看过去的评论

https://leadership.ng/2027-bauchi-govern.summary: Addresing Members of the Council at Ahmadu Bello International Conference Bauchi, Governor Bala Mohammed urged them to convince electorates through peaceful engagement and effective communication by highlighting the laudable projects and achievements recorded by the APM-led administration across the state. https://leadership.ng/2027-bauchi-govern.body: Addresing Members of the Council at Ahmadu Bello International Conference Bauchi, Governor Bala Mohammed urged them to convince electorates through peaceful engagement and effective communication by highlighting the laudable projects and achievements recorded by the APM-led administration across the state. He expressed confidence in the ability of the party’s candidates to emerge victorious in all elective positions and called on supporters to intensify grassroots mobilisation efforts. Bala Mohammed therefore announced plans for a massive empowerment programme targeting thousands of youths, women, traders and artisans across Bauchi State to improve livelihoods and economic opportunities. The Governor appreciated the APM for providing a political platform at a challenging period in the PDP, describing the opportunity as significant for their political future. Speaking on behalf of members, the Chairman of the State APM Campaign Council, Alhaji Hamza Koshe Akuyam who described APM as the most popular political party in the state, challenged candidates of other political parties to present verifiable records of their achievements to the electorate. He stressed the need for members to work collectively to ensure that the all candidates of Allied Peoples Movement APM secure victory at all levels in the 2027 general elections. Governor Bala Abdulkadir Mohammed has approved land allocation for the establishment of a Nigerian Army Armoured Corps training facility in Bauchi State, following a request by the Chief of Army Staff, Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu. The approval was granted during a courtesy visit by the Army Chief and members of the Nigerian Army High Command at Government House, Bauchi. The Governor directed the Commissioner for Lands to work with a military officer designated by the COAS to identify a suitable location for the facility. Governor Bala described the military’s contributions to maintaining peace and security in the state as significant, while commending President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the Chief of Army Staff for establishing two new Army battalions in Alkaleri and Tafawa Balewa Local Government Areas. He noted that the swift deployment of troops and logistics had made both formations operational within a short period. He identified banditry, kidnapping and illegal mining, particularly across Alkaleri, Toro, Tafawa Balewa, Bogoro and Katagum, as emerging security threats. He reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to providing logistical, intelligence and operational support to security forces, as well as assisting families of fallen military personnel. Earlier, Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu said his visit was to attend the grand finale of Exercise Mugun Bugu 2026 in Alkaleri and the maiden Nigerian Army Armoured Corps Reunion and Pulling-Out Ceremony, expected to attract more than 100 retired senior officers. He described Exercise Mugun Bugu as an annual military exercise that consolidates the Nigerian Army’s various training programmes, while appreciating Governor Bala for his continued support to the Armoured Corps and other military formations. The COAS explained that Bauchi plays an important role in the professional development of Armoured Corps personnel, adding that the expansion of the Nigerian Army from eight to twelve divisions has increased the need for dedicated training infrastructure, hence the request for a permanent training facility in the state. https://leadership.ng/2027-bauchi-govern.title_zh: 2027年：包奇州长要求进步人民运动维护礼仪并动员基层
https://leadership.ng/2027-bauchi-govern.body_zh:
在阿hmadu Bello国际会议中心向议会成员发表讲话时，巴乌奇州州长 Bala Mohammed 敦促他们通过和平接触和有效沟通说服选民，重点介绍由 APM 领导的政府在全州实施的可赞项目和取得的成就。他确信该党候选人有能力在所有选举职位中胜出，并呼吁支持者加大基层动员力度。Bala Mohammed 随后宣布，将实施大规模赋权计划，面向巴乌奇州数千名青年、妇女、商贩和手工艺人，以改善生计并增加经济机会。州长感谢 APM 在人民民主党（PDP）艰难时期提供政治平台，称这一机会对他们的政治未来意义重大。州 APM 竞选委员会主席 Alhaji Hamza Koshe Akuyam 代表成员发言，称 APM 是该州最受欢迎的政治政党，并要求其他政党的候选人向选民提交可核实的政绩记录。他强调，成员必须共同努力，确保 allied peoples movement（APM）的所有候选人在 2027 年大选中各级选举中获胜。

在陆军参谋长 Waidi Shaibu 中将提出请求后，巴拉·阿卜杜勒卡迪尔·穆罕默德州长已批准在巴乌奇州划拨土地，用于建设尼日利亚陆军装甲兵训练设施。陆军参谋长及尼日利亚陆军高级指挥层成员到访巴乌奇州政府大厦进行礼节性拜访期间，这项批准正式获得。州长指示土地事务专员与由陆军参谋长指定的军官合作，为该设施寻找合适地点。Bala 州长称，军队为维护该州和平与安全作出了重大贡献，同时赞扬总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu 和陆军参谋长在 Alkaleri 及 Tafawa Balewa 两个地方政府辖区新设了两个陆军营。他指出，部队和后勤物资迅速调派，使这两个建制在很短时间内投入运行。他将匪患、绑架和非法采矿，尤其是 Alkaleri、Toro、Tafawa Balewa、Bogoro 和 Katagum 地区出现的这些问题，列为新出现的安全威胁。他重申政府将为安全部队提供后勤、情报和行动支持，并协助阵亡军人家属。

此前，Waidi Shaibu 中将表示，此次访问是为了参加在 Alkaleri 举行的“2026年 Mugun Bugu 演习”总结活动，以及首届尼日利亚陆军装甲兵团聚暨退伍仪式，预计将有 100 多名退役高级军官参加。他称“2026年 Mugun Bugu 演习”是一项年度军事演习，旨在整合尼日利亚陆军各项训练计划，同时感谢 Bala 州长持续支持装甲兵及其他军事建制。陆军参谋长 explained，巴乌奇在装甲兵人员专业发展方面发挥着重要作用；尼日利亚陆军从 8 个师扩编至 12 个师后，对专门训练基础设施的需求增加，因此提出在该州建设永久训练设施的请求。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和第一手消息，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp 频道，全天候获取最新消息 →

https://leadership.ng/three-prestigious-.title: Three Prestigious Honours, One Extraordinary Legacy: Governor Bala Mohammed Celebrates Mahmud Yayale Ahmed
https://leadership.ng/three-prestigious-.summary: He observe that Alhaji Mahmud Yayale Ahmed’s distinguished career in the Nigerian public service, culminating in his meritorious service as Secretary to the Government of the Federation, stands as an enduring example of professionalism, administrative excellence, humility, patriotism and selfless dedication to the Nigerian project.
https://leadership.ng/three-prestigious-.summary_zh: 他指出，Alhaji Mahmud Yayale Ahmed 在尼日利亚公共服务领域的卓越职业生涯，尤其是其作为联邦政府秘书的功勋服务，是专业精神、行政卓越、谦逊、爱国主义以及无私奉献于尼日利亚国家建设的长久典范。
https://leadership.ng/three-prestigious-.body: The Governor describe these distinguished recognitions as a fitting tribute to an extraordinary life of service, excellence, integrity, intellectual accomplishment and unwavering commitment to national development. Governor Mohammed notes that these recognitions transcend the conferment of honorary titles and awards; they represent a profound institutional appreciation of a lifetime dedicated to public service, educational advancement, nation-building, institutional development and the promotion of national unity. He observe that Alhaji Mahmud Yayale Ahmed’s distinguished career in the Nigerian public service, culminating in his meritorious service as Secretary to the Government of the Federation, stands as an enduring example of professionalism, administrative excellence, humility, patriotism and selfless dedication to the Nigerian project. According to the Governor, this remarkable contributions to public administration, governance and national development have continued to inspire generations of public servants and leaders, earning him admiration and respect across political, professional, academic and traditional institutions. “ I particularly consider the recognition by the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU), Nile University, Abuja, and Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, as a powerful affirmation of the breadth, depth and enduring significance of his contributions to the advancement of society “ the Governor said . He further states that Bauchi State is immensely proud of Alhaji Mahmud Yayale Ahmed, whose exemplary career, distinguished accomplishments and outstanding national service have continued to bring honour, prestige and positive recognition to the state. While congratulating the revered elder statesman on these well-deserved honours, Governor Mohammed pray that the Almighty Allah will grant him continued good health, renewed strength, abundant wisdom and many more fruitful years of impactful service to the nation and humanity . https://leadership.ng/three-prestigious-.body_zh: 州长称，这些崇高荣誉恰如其分地褒扬了其非凡的人生履历，体现了对服务社会、追求卓越、坚守正直、智识成就以及致力于国家发展的坚定承诺。州长穆罕默德指出，这些荣誉不仅仅意味着授予荣誉称号和奖项，更体现了对其毕生投身公共服务、推动教育进步、建设国家、促进机构发展及维护国家团结的高度认可。他表示，阿尔哈吉·马哈茂德·亚亚莱·艾哈迈德在尼日利亚公共服务领域的卓越生涯，尤其是担任联邦政府秘书期间的杰出贡献，构成了专业精神、行政卓越、谦逊、爱国精神以及无私奉献于尼日利亚国家建设事业的典范。州长称，他对公共行政、治理和国家发展的卓越贡献持续激励着一代又一代公共服务人员和领导者，使他在政治、专业、学术和传统等领域赢得了广泛敬佩与尊重。州长说：“我尤其认为，由大学学术员工工会（ASUU）、阿布贾尼罗大学和乌穆迪克的迈克尔·奥克帕拉农业大学授予的这些荣誉，有力肯定了他为推动社会进步所作贡献的广度、深度和持久意义。”他还表示，巴乌奇州为阿尔哈吉·马哈茂德·亚亚莱·艾哈迈德深感自豪，其模范人生、卓越成就和杰出的国家服务继续为该州赢得荣誉、声望和积极认可。在向这位备受敬仰的资深政治家致贺并祝贺他获得这些当之无愧的荣誉时，州长穆罕默德祈祷至伟至大的安拉赐予他 continued 健康、恢复体力、增长智慧，并让他以富有成效的方式继续为国家与人类服务多年。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独特视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候最新消息 →

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mtn-group-re.body: The Board Chairman of MTN Group, Mcebisi Jonas, has reaffirmed the telecommunications and fintech giant's commitment to continued investment in Ghana, describing the country as a key market within the Group's operations. He gave the assurance during a meeting with Ghana’s Finance Minister, Dr Cassiel Ato Forson, in Accra on Wednesday, November 18, as part of activities marking MTN Ghana's 30th anniversary. Mr Jonas, who was accompanied by MTN Ghana Chief Executive Officer, Stephen Blewett, highlighted the company's contribution to economic growth and employment creation, adding that MTN remains committed to creating long-term value for Ghanaians. He also stressed the importance of collaboration between government and the private sector in advancing Ghana's digital transformation. "Ghana has been an important part of MTN's story for three decades, and our commitment to its future remains as strong as ever," he said. He added that the company intends to translate its partnership with government into investments that improve connectivity, expand opportunities and support the country's digital agenda. Dr Ato Forson welcomed the delegation and commended MTN for its sustained investment in Ghana's telecommunications and digital financial services sectors. He noted that partnerships between government and the private sector are essential to driving sustainable economic growth and creating jobs. MTN Ghana began commercial operations in 1996, becoming a pioneer in the introduction of GSM mobile telephony in the country. Over the past three decades, the company has expanded beyond telecommunications into digital financial services and other areas of the digital economy. Its contributions include capital investment, tax payments, local shareholding through its listing on the Ghana Stock Exchange, and social interventions through the MTN Ghana Foundation. The latest engagement with the Finance Ministry forms part of a series of stakeholder meetings marking the company's 30 years of operations

https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.summary: A decade later, on their three-day visit to India for the Earthshot Prize, all eyes were on the Prince and Princess of Wales, eagerly awaiting a similar fashion moment amidst possible theories about which Indian designers they would gravitate towards. The fashion moment soon arrived, this time though from Prince William who threw on a navy blue jacket from Indian handmade contemporary menswear label Kardo over a light shirt and trousers.
https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.summary_zh: 十年前，威尔士亲王与王妃为角逐地球奖访问印度。在为期三天的行程中，所有目光都聚焦在这对王室夫妇身上，大家热切期待他们再现时尚时刻，同时外界也在猜测他们会青睐哪些印度设计师。时尚时刻很快到来，不过这一次来自威廉王子。他内搭浅色衬衫、搭配长裤，外穿印度手工当代男装品牌Kardo的海军蓝夹克。
https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription On an April 2016 royal visit to India, Britain’s Princess Catherine of Wales served up one of the most talked-about fashion moments from her tour, dressed in a pink and blue printed tunic by Anita Dongre , while she played a friendly game of cricket at the Oval Maidan. The cheery, Mughal-print dress caused the designer’s e-commerce website to crash hours later as people flocked to enquire and place orders. A decade later, on their three-day visit to India for the Earthshot Prize, all eyes were on the Prince and Princess of Wales, eagerly awaiting a similar fashion moment amidst possible theories about which Indian designers they would gravitate towards. The fashion moment soon arrived, this time though from Prince William who threw on a navy blue jacket from Indian handmade contemporary menswear label Kardo over a light shirt and trousers. The jacket was his pick for a game of cricket at Ballard Estate where he was joined by Princess Kate and cricketing legend Sachin Tendulkar, surprising and delighting fashion watchers with his choice of an Indian label; one that has a story to tell about its commitment to promoting the country’s craft. “We have been doing this for over 13 years, and are with at least 150 retailers across the world. But the last few days have truly felt like many more people have woken up to Kardo,” laughs Rikki Kher, founder and creative director of the Noida-based label. Rikki says that the label made a selection of pieces for Prince William, including contemporary trousers, jackets and suits. “I also decided to make a Nehru jacket; a quintessentially Indian piece which is also contemporary and something that easily translates into a non-Indian setting as well. The silhouette is a representation of our sartorial flair,” he says. Kardo’s fashion moment, and the subsequent discovery of its brand story by those in India who may have been unfamiliar with its design philosophy and engagement with craft, was perhaps one of the few interesting fashion stories to emerge from the royals’ recently concluded visit to India. At the Earthshot Prize green carpet, which saw the attendance of several celebrities, notably Bollywood representatives, there was relatively little visibility for brands whose work spotlights sustainability, craft and responsible production. It was a missed opportunity, given the platform the event offered to spark a wider conversation around circularity, fashion’s environmental impact and the ways in which design can be more conscious. Made of 100% handloom cotton in Harali, West Bengal, Rikki speaks of developing the fabric for the Prince’s Nehru jacket with a team from Glocal Weaves, founded by Fatima Radiowala. “This fabric is woven on a traditional hand loom in West Bengal using the extra weft technique, where an additional yarn is introduced across the warp to create motifs and patterns, each woven by hand, pick by pick,” he says. According to Rikki, this extra weft technique was the result of several years of experimentation and refinement since the fabric here needed to accommodate a heavier double-ply cotton yarn. “The result is a fabric that is truly a labour of love, skill and countless hours of work,” he says. For the Nehru jacket in the news, Netai Mana, Uday Ji and Brojokishore Maity of Glocalweaves from West Bengal have been credited as the weavers, and at the Kardo workshop in Noida, the jacket was hand cut by Jahid Ali and stitched by Virender. Traditional weaving, dying and printing techniques, as well as fabrics such as natural dyed handloom, block printing, ikat, natural indigo denim, shibori and chikankari embroidery feature in Kardo’s line of menswear through craft clusters from across the country. Rikki speaks of the brand’s commitment to transparency, sharing and community, reflected in how every person who has worked on a garment is credited. “We also follow a specialised ONExONE production of our clothing where each item is hand-cut, sewn by a single tailor from beginning to end. As a brand that was built with the vision of being the anti-thesis of fast fashion, I wondered how we could go back to the traditional way of making clothes when a tailor was invested and involved in making the whole garment,” he explains. While Kardo does not call itself a sustainable brand, Rikki speaks of how they work as a low environmental-impact brand and their vision to work in circularity. “When we look at working with an artisanal cluster or group, we want to look at building a long-term relationship. This is not just about working on garments for a single season, but to start small and grow with them. We do not want to create weaves or fabrics that will become unfashionable after one season.” ALSO WATCH Earthshot Prize winners offer hope for climate action amid global diplomatic deadlock Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.title_zh: 威廉王子身穿尼赫鲁夹克，让印度品牌Kardo在“地球卫士”巡回活动中受到关注
https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/.body_zh: 订阅可享受《Premium Stories》《Editorials》《Opinions》等内容的阅读权益。开通订阅即可解锁这些内容。2016年4月，英国威尔士王妃凯瑟琳对印度进行王室访问期间，她在椭圆广场打了一场友谊板球赛，身穿 Anita Dongre 设计的粉蓝印花长衫， 成为此次访问中最受热议的时尚瞬间之一。这件 cheerful  Mughal 印花服装在数小时后便导致设计师的电子商务网站崩溃，因为人们纷纷前来咨询并下单。十年后，威尔士亲王与王妃为地球摄影奖访问印度三天，所有人的目光都聚焦在这对王室夫妇身上，期待着再次出现类似的时尚时刻；与此同时，各种关于他们会选择哪位印度设计师的猜测也随之浮现。这一次，时尚时刻很快到来，主角是威廉王子。他身穿印度手工当代男装品牌 Kardo 的藏蓝色外套，内搭浅色衬衫和长裤，在 Ballard Estate 打板球时选择了这件夹克。凯特王妃和板球传奇人物 Sachin Tendulkar 也一同参与；王子选择印度本土品牌，令时尚观察者既惊讶又欣喜。这个品牌还有一个值得关注的故事，体现了它对推广本国手工艺的投入。“我们从事这项事业已有13年多，与全球至少150家零售商合作。但最近几天，大家醒来后真的都知道了 Kardo，感觉像是突然多了许多人对我们关注起来。”驻诺伊达该品牌的创始人兼创意总监 Rikki Kher 笑着说。Rikki 表示，品牌为威廉王子挑选了一系列单品，包括当代风格长裤、夹克和西装。“我还决定制作一件尼赫鲁夹克；这是一种最具印度特色的单品，同时也具有当代感，而且也很容易在非印度环境中穿出效果。廓形体现了我们的穿搭风格。”Kardo 的这次时尚亮相，以及印度一些此前可能并不了解其设计理念和工艺参与方式的消费者随后发现其品牌故事，或许是王室刚刚结束印度访问后涌现的少数几个有趣时尚故事之一。在地球摄影奖红毯上，多位名人出席，包括宝莱坞明星代表，但那些主打可持续性、手工艺和负责任生产的品牌却鲜有亮相。考虑到该活动提供了一个推动更广泛讨论的平台，本来可以围绕循环经济、时尚产业的环境影响，以及如何让设计更具环保意识展开对话，这不得不说是一个错失的机会。这块面料由位于西孟加拉邦 Harali 的纯手工机织棉制成。Rikki 表示，他与 Glocal Weaves 团队合作，为王子的尼赫鲁夹克开发这种面料；该品牌由 Fatima Radiowala 创立。“这种面料在西孟加拉邦使用传统手工织机，以额外纬线工艺织造，即在经线上加入另一根纬线，形成图案和纹样，每一针都完全由手工织成。”他说。据 Rikki 介绍，这种额外纬线工艺源于数年的试验与改进，因为这种面料需要适应更重的双股棉纱。“最终得到的面料，真正凝聚着热爱、技艺和无数小时的劳动。”他说。对于这登上新闻的尼赫鲁夹克，来自西孟加拉邦 Glocalweaves 的 Netai Mana、Uday Ji 和 Brojokishore Maity 被列为织工；在诺伊达的 Kardo 工作坊，这件夹克由 Jahid Ali 手工裁剪，由 Virender 缝制。传统编织、染色和印花工艺，以及天然染色手工织布、块印花、ikat、天然靛蓝牛仔布、shibori 和 chikankari 刺绣等面料，均通过来自印度各地的工艺集群应用于 Kardo 的男装系列。Rikki 表示，品牌致力于透明、分享和社区精神，这体现在参与每件服装制作的每一个人都会获得署名。“我们的服装还采用专门的 ONExONE 生产方式，每件商品从裁剪到缝制均由同一位裁缝独立完成。这个品牌的创立愿景与快时尚背道而驰，因此我一直在思考，当裁缝对整件服装投入并全程参与时，我们如何回归传统制衣方式。”他解释道。尽管 Kardo 并不将自己称为可持续品牌，Rikki 却表示，他们以低环境影响品牌的方式开展业务，并致力于推动循环经济。“当我们与手工艺集群或工匠群体合作时，我希望建立长期关系。这不只是为一个季度制作几件服装，而是从小处开始，与他们共同成长。我们不希望创造出一个流行季后就会过时的织法或面料。”另请观看：在全球外交僵局之中，地球摄影奖获奖者为气候行动带来希望。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得包含辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与文章互动。如果你还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的 Vuukle 账户后，可以查看以前的评论。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112011.summary: (베이징=연합뉴스) 정성조 특파원 = 중국은 선전 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 참석차 중국을 방문한 인도네시아·호주·싱가포르·태국·말레이시아 등 각국 정상과 시진핑 국가주석의 정상회담 소식을 전하면서 인공지능(AI) 협력과 대만 문제 등에 관한 자국 입장을 피력했다. 20일 신화통신에 따르면 시 주석은 이날 중국 남부 광둥성 선전에서 프라보워 수비안토 인도네시아 대통령과 만나 "현재 양국은 모두 현대화 추진과 국가 장기 안정 실현, 양호한 외부 환경 조성이라는 공동 임무에 직면해 있다"며 "양국은 전방위적인 전략적 협력을 심화해 운명공동체 건설이 끊임없이 새로운 단계로 나아가도록 해야 한다"고 말했다. 시진핑 주석은 양국이 외부 위험 공동 대응은 물론 자카르타-반둥 고속철도 사업과 양국의 상호 산업단지 건설 등 대형 프로젝트 공조 강화, 에너지·AI·디지털경제·청정에너지 협력 심화 등에 나서자고 제안했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112011.summary_zh: （北京＝韩联社）特派记者郑性珠报道：中国以出席亚洲太平洋经济合作组织（APEC）为由访问期间，报道了与印度尼西亚、澳大利亚、新加坡、泰国、马来西亚等国领导人及习近平主席举行会晤的消息，并阐明了本国在人工智能（AI）合作和台湾问题等方面的立场。据新华社20日报道，习近平主席当天在中国广东省汕头会见了印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏班迪安诺，并表示：“当前，两国都面临推进现代化、实现国家长期稳定以及营造良好外部环境这一共同使命。”“两国应深化全方面战略合作，推动建设命运共同体不断迈上新台阶。”习近平主席提议，两国不仅应共同应对外部风险，还应加强雅加达—万隆高速铁路项目和两国互建产业园区等大型项目的协作，并深化能源、AI、数字经济和清洁能源合作。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112011.body: (베이징=연합뉴스) 정성조 특파원 = 중국은 선전 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 참석차 중국을 방문한 인도네시아·호주·싱가포르·태국·말레이시아 등 각국 정상과 시진핑 국가주석의 정상회담 소식을 전하면서 인공지능(AI) 협력과 대만 문제 등에 관한 자국 입장을 피력했다. 20일 신화통신에 따르면 시 주석은 이날 중국 남부 광둥성 선전에서 프라보워 수비안토 인도네시아 대통령과 만나 "현재 양국은 모두 현대화 추진과 국가 장기 안정 실현, 양호한 외부 환경 조성이라는 공동 임무에 직면해 있다"며 "양국은 전방위적인 전략적 협력을 심화해 운명공동체 건설이 끊임없이 새로운 단계로 나아가도록 해야 한다"고 말했다. 시진핑 주석은 양국이 외부 위험 공동 대응은 물론 자카르타-반둥 고속철도 사업과 양국의 상호 산업단지 건설 등 대형 프로젝트 공조 강화, 에너지·AI·디지털경제·청정에너지 협력 심화 등에 나서자고 제안했다. 시 주석은 같은 날 미국의 주요 동맹국인 호주의 앤서니 앨버니지 총리와의 회담에서는 "중국과 호주는 역사적인 원한이 없고 근본적인 이익 충돌도 없는 만큼 서로 신뢰하고 성취하는 협력 파트너가 돼야 한다"고 강조했다. 그러면서 상호 신뢰 증진과 이성적·우호적인 대우, 농업·에너지·광물·디지털산업·AI 등 영역에서의 협력 추진, 인문 교류 확대, 유엔을 핵심으로 하는 국제 질서 공동 수호 등의 양국 관계 진전 원칙을 제시했다. 시 주석은 로런스 웡 싱가포르 총리를 만난 자리에서는 "중국과 싱가포르는 서로 신임하는 진정한 친구가 돼야 하고, 정치적 상호신뢰를 다지면서 공동의 이익을 수호해야 한다"고 했다. 그는 '일대일로'(一帶一路:중국-중앙아시아-유럽을 연결하는 육상·해상 실크로드) 사업 공동 건설과 양국 자유무역협정(FTA) 4.0 버전 협상 개시, 디지털경제·녹색발전·AI 등 영역에서의 협력 성과 창출 등 방침을 언급하면서 APEC과 아세안 등 다자주의 틀 안에서의 협력 강화를 바란다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 그는 태국을 '일가 친척'(一家親)이라 부르면서 아누틴 찬위라꾼 태국 총리를 향해 무역·과학기술·AI·신에너지차·항공·우주·수자원 등 협력에 나서자고 했고, 안와르 이브라힘 말레이시아 총리에게는 중점 프로젝트 건설·운영과 농산물 무역·관광·교육 등에서 힘을 합치자고 제언했다. 신화통신은 이날 시 주석과 회담을 연 각국 정상이 중국과 무역·투자·AI 등 분야 협력을 강화하겠다고 말한 내용과 중국의 국제적 책임, 대만 문제 등에 관한 각국의 입장을 소개했다. 통신에 따르면 앨버지니 총리는 "호주는 '하나의 중국' 정책을 견지할 것을 약속하고, 중국과 고위급 교류를 긴밀히 하면서 무역·투자·AI 등 영역의 실용적 협력을 강화할 의향이 있다"며 "현재 혼란한 세계에서 중국은 중요한 안정의 힘"이라고 했다. 최근 엔비디아 첨단 반도체의 중국 우회 유입 경로 중 하나로 지목된 싱가포르는 중국과 협력을 더 심화하겠다는 의지를 확인했다. 신화통신에 따르면 웡 총리는 "싱가포르는 '하나의 중국' 정책을 굳게 지키고 있고, '대만 독립'에 반대한다"며 "층위별 교류와 무역·공급망·AI 등 협력을 강화하고, 인문 교류를 증진해 양국 관계가 부단히 발전하도록 추진할 의향이 있다"고 했다. 프라보워 대통령은 "인도네시아는 중국이 국제 문제에서 책임 있는 강대국의 역할을 발휘하는 것을 높이 평가하고, 중국과 함께 다자주의 수호와 글로벌 거버넌스 개선, '글로벌사우스'(Global South·주로 남반구에 위치한 신흥국과 개도국을 통칭) 공동 이익 수호, 지역·세계의 평화·안정 수호를 해나갈 것"이라며 "인도네시아는 '하나의 중국' 정책을 굳게 지키고 있고, 대만을 중화인민공화국의 한 성(省)으로 간주한다"고 말했다고 신화통신은 전했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/20 18:07 송고 2026년11월20일 18시07분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112011.body_zh: （北京＝韩联社）韩国常驻记者成政柱＝中国在宣传其出席亚洲太平洋经济合作组织（APEC）期间访问中国之际，报道了与印度尼西亚、澳大利亚、新加坡、泰国、马来西亚等国领导人以及习近平国家主席举行会晤的消息，并阐述了中国在人工智能（AI）合作和台湾问题等方面的立场。据新华通讯社20日报道，习近平主席当天在中国广东省汕头与印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏班安托会晤时表示：“当前，中两国都面临着推进现代化、实现国家长期稳定、营造良好外部环境的共同任务。双方应深化全方位战略合作，推动命运共同体建设不断迈上新台阶。”习近平主席提议，双方不仅共同应对外部风险，还应加强雅加达—万隆高速铁路项目和两国相互产业园建设等大型项目的合作协调，深化能源、AI、数字经济和清洁能源等领域的合作。同日，习近平主席与澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯会谈时强调：“中澳两国没有历史夙愿，也没有根本性利益冲突，应当成为相互信任、合作共赢的伙伴。”他提出推进两国关系发展的原则，包括增进相互信任、理性友善地对待对方，推动农业、能源、矿业、数字产业和AI等领域合作，扩大人文交流，并以联合国为核心共同维护国际秩序。习近平主席在会见新加坡总理劳伦斯·王时表示：“中新两国应成为彼此信任的真正朋友，在增强政治互信的同时维护共同利益。”他提到共同建设“一带一路”（连接中国—中亚—欧洲的陆上和海上丝绸之路）项目，启动两国自由贸易协定（FTA）4.0版谈判，在数字经济、绿色发展和AI等领域取得合作成果，并表达了加强在APEC和东盟等多边主义框架内合作的意愿。习近平主席称泰国为“一家人”，向泰国总理阿努廷·查维拉提议在贸易、科学技术、AI、新能源汽车、航空航天和水资源等领域开展合作；他还向马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣建议，双方在重点项目建设与运营、农产品贸易、旅游和教育等方面共同努力。新华社介绍了当天与习近平主席会晤的各国领导人有关加强与中国在贸易、投资和AI等领域合作的表态，以及各国对中国的国际责任和台湾问题等立场的看法。据报道，阿尔巴尼斯总理表示：“澳大利亚承诺坚持‘一个中国’政策，在与中国加强高层交往的同时，愿在贸易、投资和AI等领域加强务实合作。中国是当今动荡世界中的一股重要稳定力量。”新加坡近期被列为先进NVIDIA半导体绕道进入中国渠道之一，吴政耀总理借此确认了深化与中国合作的意愿。据新华社报道，吴总理表示：“新加坡坚定坚持‘一个中国’政策，反对‘台湾独立’，愿加强各层级交往以及贸易、供应链和AI等领域的合作，推动两国关系不断发展。”新华社称，普拉博沃总统表示：“印度尼西亚高度赞赏中国在国际事务中发挥负责任大国作用，愿与中国一道维护多边主义、改善全球治理，守护‘全球南方’（Global South，主要指位于南半球的新兴经济体和发展中国家）的共同利益，为地区和世界的和平稳定作出贡献。印度尼西亚坚定坚持‘一个中国’政策，视台湾为中华人民共和国的一个省。”版权（c）韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布及用于AI学习和应用。2026年11月20日18时07分发稿。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112010.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 최평천 최주성 기자 = 더불어민주당이 20일 조희대 대법원장 탄핵 소추를 당론으로 공식 채택하면서 헌정사상 초유의 대법원장 탄핵 심판이 초읽기에 들어갔다. 절대 과반 의석인 민주당 등 범여권이 탄핵을 밀어붙이고 국민의힘 등 보수 야권이 거세게 반발하면서 조 대법원장을 둘러싼 여야 공방이 치열하게 전개될 것으로 보인다. 민주당은 이날 국회에서 의원총회를 열어 당론 채택 안건을 통과시켰다고 전은수 원내대변인이 기자들에게 밝혔다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112010.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者崔平灿、崔柱成＝共同民主党20日正式将弹劾大法院院长赵睽大作为党内决议通过，宪法史上首次针对大法院院长的弹劾审判进入初审阶段。拥有绝对多数席位的共同民主党等在野进步阵营力推动弹劾，而国民力量等在野保守阵营则激烈反对，预计围绕赵大法院院长的朝野攻防将热烈展开。共同民主党当天在国会召开议员全体会议并通过弹劾决议案，该党院内代表全善秀向记者透露了这一消息。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112010.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 최평천 최주성 기자 = 더불어민주당이 20일 조희대 대법원장 탄핵 소추를 당론으로 공식 채택하면서 헌정사상 초유의 대법원장 탄핵 심판이 초읽기에 들어갔다. 절대 과반 의석인 민주당 등 범여권이 탄핵을 밀어붙이고 국민의힘 등 보수 야권이 거세게 반발하면서 조 대법원장을 둘러싼 여야 공방이 치열하게 전개될 것으로 보인다. 민주당은 이날 국회에서 의원총회를 열어 당론 채택 안건을 통과시켰다고 전은수 원내대변인이 기자들에게 밝혔다. 대법원이 내란 중요임무 종사 혐의로 기소된 한덕수 전 국무총리에게 징역 15년을 선고한 2심 판결 중 일부를 무죄 취지로 파기 환송한 지 하루만이다. 당 탄핵소추 추진단장을 맡은 양부남 의원은 의총 뒤 발의 시점에 대해 "구체적 시기는 말하기 어렵고 가능한 한 빠른 시간내 할 것"이라며 "내년으로 넘어가지 않을 것"이라고 밝혔다. 민주당이 제시한 조 대법원장의 탄핵 소추 사유는 ▲ 12·3 비상계엄 당시 대법원의 대응 ▲ 대법원의 이재명 대통령 공직선거법 위반 사건 파기환송 ▲ 대법관 재제청 논란 ▲ 업무추진비 집행과 현금 격려금 지급 의혹 등이다. 양 의원은 12·3 비상계엄 당시 대법원의 대응 문제와 관련, "2024년 12월 3일 밤 (사법부가) 비상계엄 지휘와 통상 매뉴얼에 따라 대비한다는 언론보도가 있었다"며 "비상계엄이 적법하다는 것을 기정사실화하고 비상계엄에 순응하고 협력하겠다는 의사 표시로 보인다"고 지적했다. 양 의원은 의원총회 직후 한 전 총리에 대한 대법원 선고 자체는 탄핵 사유가 아니라고 밝혔지만, 의총 이후 열린 추진단 회의를 마친 뒤에는 탄핵 사유로 검토하겠다고 입장을 바꿨다. 양 의원은 "추진단에서 충분히 토론과 논쟁을 한 결과 검토할 필요 있다고 생각한다"며 "(판결이) 적절하지 않다고 판단하는 것"이라고 말했다. 양 의원은 한 전 총리가 비상계엄 선포 전 국무회의를 건의한 행위에서 '국헌문란 목적'을 인정하기 어렵다고 본 대법원 다수의견과 관련, "합법성 외피를 부여하려 한 것이라는 게 소수의견이었는데, 소수의견이 국민 법 감정과 맞는다고 생각한다"고 말했다. 양 의원은 대법원 선고를 탄핵 사유로 포함하는 내용이 당 원내지도부의 결정인지를 묻자 "추진단 결정"이라며 "추진단에서 소추안을 완성하면, 최종적으로 원내로 넘어가서 원내에서 결정할 것"이라고 답했다. 혁신당 신장식 대표는 이날 기자회견을 열어 "더 지체할 이유도 없다. 논의 시간이 길어질수록 내란 세력에게 저항의 시간과 명분만 줄 뿐"이라며 "오늘 소추안을 국회에 제출하고 즉시 본회의에 보고하면 토요일 본회의를 열어 바로 표결할 수 있다"고 말했다. 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 홍대 일대에서 열린 현장 원내대책회의에서 "조 대법원장 한 사람을 상대로 반역이니 내란이니 하며 탄핵을 추진하는 건 광기이며 국가적 비극"이라고 비판했다. 박충권 수석대변인도 논평에서 "민주당 의총에서조차 보복으로 비칠 수 있다는 우려가 나왔다는데도 탄핵으로 의견이 모였다니, 이재명 대통령 선거법 사건 파기환송, 대법관 재제청 거부에 이어 정권이 내민 '청구서'라는 의심을 피할 수 없다"고 꼬집었다. 개혁신당 이동훈 수석대변인은 논평에서 "이번 판결은 대법원 전원합의체의 판단이다. 조 대법원장 혼자 내린 게 아니다. 대법원장을 끌어내리겠다는 것은 사법부 전체에 정권의 눈치를 보라는 협박"이라고 지적했다. 무소속 한동훈 의원은 국회에서 기자들과 만나 "민주당의 대법원장 탄핵 시도는 민주공화정을 무너뜨리는 친위쿠데타이자 내란"이라며 "도요토미 히데요시가 내부 불만 잠재워보려 임진왜란을 일으킨 것과 같다. 히데요시는 정권 이후 죽었고, 민주당의 말로도 같을 것"이라고 맹비난했다. 대법원장 탄핵의 경우 국회 재적의원 3분의 1 이상이 탄핵소추안을 발의하고 재적의원 과반수가 찬성해야 국회를 통과할 수 있다. 민주당 단독으로 탄핵안 발의부터 본회의 처리까지 가능한 셈이다. 헌재는 탄핵 심판을 접수한 날로부터 180일 이내에 탄핵 인용이나 기각 결정을 선고해야 하고, 재판관 9명 중 6명 이상이 탄핵 심판 청구가 이유가 있다고 판단하면 파면된다. 1985년 12대 국회에서 신한민주당은 유태흥 대법원장이 일선 판사들에게 불공정한 인사 조처를 했다는 이유로 탄핵소추안을 발의한 바 있다. 당시 탄핵안은 본회의에서 부결됐다. 2009년 18대 국회에서는 '광우병 촛불집회 재판 개입' 의혹을 받은 신영철 대법관에 대한 탄핵소추안이 발의됐지만 72시간 이내 표결이 이뤄지지 않아 자동 폐기됐다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/20 18:06 송고 2026년11월20일 18시06분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 김주형 기자 = 조희대 대법원장이 20일 서울 서초구 대법원으로 출근하고 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112010.title_zh: 大法院院长弹劾案因执政党采纳而首次具有重大意义，国民党斥责其“狂妄”（综合3条报道）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026112010.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权平谦、崔柱成记者＝共同民主党20日正式以党议决定通过弹劾大法院长赵兑大案，宪法史上首次针对大法院长的弹劾审判由此拉开帷幕。共同民主党等在野阵营拥有绝对过半议席，正大力推动弹劾，而国民力量等保守在野阵营则强烈反弹，预计围绕赵大法院长的朝野攻防将激烈展开。共同民主党当天在国会召开议员总会议，院内代表全善树向记者表示，弹劾追诉动议已获通过。就在法院以叛乱重要任务终止嫌疑被起诉的韩德秀前国务总理二审判决中，部分内容以无罪为由被撤销并发回重审的仅一天之后。担任该党弹劾追诉推进团团长的梁富南议员在议员总会议后谈及提案时间称：“具体时间难以说明，但会尽可能在短期内提出，不会拖到明年。”共同民主党提出的弹劾赵大法院长的理由包括：▲12·3紧急戒严期间大法院的应对；▲大法院撤销并发回李在明总统违反公职选举法案件；▲大法官再审申请争议；▲业务推进费使用及发放现金奖励金等疑点。梁议员就12·3紧急戒严期间大法院的应对问题表示：“媒体报道称，2024年12月3日晚，（司法部门）依据紧急戒严指挥及通常手册采取了应对措施。从相关表述来看，大法院似乎把紧急戒严合法化当作既定事实，并表明了服从和配合紧急戒严的意向。”梁议员表示，大法院对前国务总理作出的判决本身并非弹劾理由，但在议员总会议后举行的推进团会议结束后，他改变立场，表示将把该判决作为弹劾理由进行审议。梁议员说：“推进团经过充分讨论和争论后，我认为有必要进行审议，也就是（判决）并不恰当。”当被问及大法院多数意见难以认定前国务总理在紧急戒严宣布前建议召开国务会议的行为具有“扰乱国宪目的”时，梁议员表示：“认为这只是少数意见，试图赋予其合法性外衣，但我认为少数意见符合国民的法律感情。”当被问及把大法院判决列为弹劾理由的内容是否属于党内院内指导部的决定时，梁议员回答称：“这是推进团的决定。推进团完成弹劾案后，最终会提交院内，由院内作出决定。”革新党新相植当天举行记者会说：“已经没有继续拖延的理由。讨论时间拖得越长，只会为叛乱势力提供更多抵抗的时间和借口。今天把弹劾案提交国会并立即报告全体会议，就能召开星期六的全体会议进行表决。”国民力量院内代表郑点式当天在弘大地区举行的现场院内对策会议上批评称：“针对赵大法院长一人，以叛乱、内乱为由推动弹劾是疯狂之举，也是国家的悲剧。”朴忠权首席副代表也在评论中写道：“即便在共同民主党议员总会议上，也有人担忧此举会被视为报复，但各方仍就弹劾达成一致；在大法院撤销并发回李在明总统选举法案件、拒绝大法官再审申请之后，执政党难以摆脱外界对其抛出‘催款单’的怀疑。”开革新党首席副代表李东勋在评论中指出：“这次判决是大法院全体合议体的判断，并非赵大法院长一人作出。罢免大法院长，是恐吓整个司法部门向执政党看齐。”无党派议员韩东勋在国会对记者表示：“共同民主党试图弹劾大法院长，是摧毁民主共和宪政的亲卫政变，也是内乱。”他猛烈抨击道：“这就像东条英机为消除内部不满而发动未遂政变。东条在政权垮台后身亡，依共同民主党所说，他也难逃同样的命运。”大法院长弹劾案须由国会三分之一以上在籍议员提出弹劾案，并获得在籍议员过半数赞成，才能在国会获得通过。共同民主党单独即可完成从提出弹劾案到交由全体会议审议的全过程。宪法法院须在收到弹劾审判之日起180日内作出准予弹劾或驳回的判决；9名审判员中若有6名以上认为弹劾审判请求理由成立，大法院长即遭解职。1985年第12届国会中，新韩民主党曾以大法院长禹泰兴对一线法官进行不公平人事安排为由，提出弹劾案，但该案在全体会议被否决。2009年第18届国会中，曾有人以涉嫌介入‘光雨病蜡烛集会审判’为由，对大法官申永哲提出弹劾案，但因未能在72小时内进行表决而自动失效。报道：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、转载及用于人工智能训练和利用> 2026/11/20 18:06发稿 2026年11月20日18时06分发稿（首尔=韩联社）金珠형记者＝赵兑大大法院长20日到首尔瑞草区大法院上班。2026.11.20 kjhpress@yna.co.kr

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs. The organisation said the decision contradicted the All Progressives Congress (APC)’s promises on job creation and raised concerns about the government’s commitment to addressing unemployment. In a press statement dated November 17, 2026, and signed by its Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Nnanna Ihediwa, the campaign organisation described the recruitment freeze as an indication of what it called the shortcomings of the Tinubu administration’s economic policies. It also expressed concern that the embargo could precede possible mass retrenchment in the public service under the guise of fiscal discipline, particularly if Tinubu secured re-election in 2027. The organisation cited World Bank estimates that approximately 3.5 million Nigerians enter the labour market annually, arguing that restricting federal recruitment would further limit employment opportunities for young people. The MDPCO also rejected the Presidency’s explanation that the embargo was intended to consolidate public service reforms and enable the government to properly determine personnel requirements for the 2027 budget. It argued that the government should instead focus on expanding the economy, harnessing the country’s human and natural resources, and creating employment opportunities. The campaign organisation further faulted comments attributed to the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, describing Nigerians complaining about hunger and hardship as lazy. According to the statement, the 2027 general election would provide Nigerians an opportunity to assess the economic direction of the country and decide on the leadership they want. It contrasted the Federal Government’s recruitment policy with what it described as employment-generating initiatives under Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde. The organisation said Makinde’s administration had expanded economic opportunities in Oyo State through public and private sector initiatives, particularly in agriculture, infrastructure, education, transportation and other critical sectors. It specifically highlighted the establishment of the Oyo State Agribusiness Development Agency (OYSADA), which it said had transformed traditional farm settlements into modern agro-industrial hubs. Other initiatives cited included investments in power generation, aviation, road infrastructure, water resources, revenue reforms and improvements in the public workforce. The campaign organisation said Makinde’s proposed RESET Nigeria Agenda was anchored on expanding economic opportunities, reducing waste without weakening public institutions, maintaining fiscal discipline without restricting employment, and pursuing economic stability without undermining citizens’ livelihoods. It said the agenda offered an alternative economic direction ahead of the 2027 presidential election. The organisation urged Nigerians to consider Makinde, who is the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), for the 2027 election, arguing that his administration’s development approach in Oyo State could be replicated at the national level. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队就联邦招聘禁令指责蒂努布
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body_zh:
第一层 马金德－达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定禁止联邦政府机构招聘，称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境缺乏体谅，尤其是对正在寻找工作的年轻人。该组织表示，这项决定与进步大会党（APC）关于创造就业岗位的承诺相悖，并引发人们对政府解决失业问题承诺的担忧。

在一份日期为2026年11月17日、由其战略传播主任理查德·恩南纳·伊赫迪瓦签署的新闻声明中，该竞选组织称冻结招聘凸显了其所称的蒂努布政府经济政策的缺陷。它还担忧，这项禁令可能先于公共部门可能发生的大规模裁员，而裁员将以财政纪律为名，尤其是在蒂努布于2027年成功连任的情况下。该组织援引世界银行的估算称，每年约有350万名尼日利亚人进入劳动力市场，并认为限制联邦招聘将进一步减少年轻人的就业机会。

MDPCO还驳斥了总统府关于实施招聘禁令旨在巩固公共服务改革、使政府能够妥善确定2027年预算人员需求的解释。它认为，政府转而应当专注于扩大经济，开发国家的人力和自然资源，并创造就业机会。

该竞选组织还批评了据称出自APC总统竞选委员会主任、阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里参议员的言论，称他把抱怨饥饿和困苦的尼日利亚人描述为懒惰。

声明表示，2027年大选将为尼日利亚人提供一次机会，以评估国家经济的发展方向，并决定他们希望由谁领导。该组织将联邦政府的招聘政策与其所称的奥约州州长塞伊·马金德推行的就业创造举措进行了对比。该组织说，马金德政府通过公共和私营部门的举措扩大了奥约州的经济机会，尤其是在农业、基础设施、教育、交通运输及其他关键领域。

该组织特别提到成立奥约州农业综合发展局（OYSADA），并称该机构已把传统农庄转变为现代农工业中心。列举的其他举措包括对发电、航空、道路基础设施、水资源、税收改革和公共 workforce 改善的投资。

该竞选组织表示，马金德提出的“重置尼日利亚议程”以扩大经济机会、在不削弱公共机构的情况下减少浪费、在不限制就业的情况下维持财政纪律，以及在不损害公民生计的情况下追求经济稳定为基础。它称，在2027年总统选举前夕，该议程提供了一条替代性的经济发展道路。

该组织敦促尼日利亚人在2027年大选中考虑马金德。他是联盟人民运动（APM）的总统候选人。该组织认为，他在奥约州采用的发展方式可以在全国范围内复制。

Unlock these with Subscription India has escalated its targeting of religious minorities during a voter list revision that struck off tens of millions of names nationwide, a U.S. panel on religious freedom said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). “The Indian gov’t is targeting Muslim citizens by removing them from voter rolls, calling them ‘foreigners,’ and now illegally deporting them,” Asif Mahmood, the chair of the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom, said in a statement. India’s voter list revision removed 130 million names, roughly the population of Mexico, in the largest deletion of voters in the country’s history. Data shows the omissions disproportionately affect Muslims , India’s largest minority, who have faced what rights groups describe as exclusionary policies and rising discrimination since Prime Minister Narendra Modi took power in 2014. The Election Commission of India says it was removing duplicate, deceased, shifted and otherwise ineligible voters and that anyone excluded in error can pursue appeals. The revision has become entangled with a separate drive to identify and expel suspected illegal immigrants, even though removal from the rolls does not itself establish that someone is a foreigner. “The Indian government’s expulsion of its own citizens based on their Muslim faith is a shocking escalation of tactics that target religious minorities,” said Gene Mills, a commissioner on the U.S. panel. Mr. Mills urged the State Department to designate India as a “country of particular concern.” USCIRF is a bipartisan body of the U.S. government that monitors religious freedom around the world and makes policy recommendations, which are not binding. Washington has not acted on its recent recommendations on India. The Ministry of External Affairs has cast USCIRF as biased. New Delhi has repeatedly dismissed such criticism and called it interference in the country’s internal affairs. The Indian Embassy in Washington did not respond to a request for comment. The voter roll revisions sparked protests in recent weeks, with opposition groups and student demonstrators saying the revisions affected those unlikely to vote for the BJP. Rights experts condemned India’s crackdown on the protests. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said last month the issue was a “domestic political matter” and Washington would not comment on it. UN experts and human rights groups say abuse of minorities has risen under Mr. Modi. They point to rising hate speech, a religion-based citizenship law that the UN calls “fundamentally discriminatory,” the demolition of Muslim-owned properties, and anti-conversion legislation that challenges freedom of belief. Civil rights advocates have also been critical of the treatment of Muslims in the U.S. while noting a rise in Islamophobia in recent years and documenting escalating anti-Muslim rhetoric from Republicans during election campaigns. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body_zh:
订阅可享受高级新闻、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。

印度在修订选民名册期间加大了对宗教少数群体的 targeting。美国宗教自由委员会周四（2026年11月19日）表示称，这次修订在全国范围内删除了数千万人的姓名。

美国国际宗教自由委员会主席阿西夫·马哈茂德在一份声明中说：“印度政府通过将穆斯林公民从选民名册中删除、称他们为‘外国人’，如今还非法驱逐他们，以此针对穆斯林公民。”

印度选民名册修订删除了1.3亿个姓名，大致相当于墨西哥的人口，是该国历史上规模最大的一次选民删除。数据显示，被遗漏者不成比例地影响了作为印度最大少数群体的穆斯林。自2014年纳伦德拉·莫迪总理就任以来，人权组织称穆斯林一直面临排斥性政策和日益上升的歧视。

印度选举委员会表示，删除重复、已死亡、迁居以及其他不符合资格的选民，任何因错误而被排除者都可以提出申诉。

尽管从选民名册中删除姓名本身并不能证明某人是外国人，但这次修订已与另一项识别和驱逐涉嫌非法移民的行动交织在一起。

美国国际宗教自由委员会委员吉恩·米尔斯说：“印度政府仅因本国公民信仰伊斯兰教就将其驱逐，这是针对宗教少数群体策略的令人震惊的升级。”

米尔斯先生敦促美国国务院将印度列为“特别关注国家”。

美国国际宗教自由委员会是美国政府下属的两党联合机构，负责监测全球宗教自由并提出不具约束力的政策建议。华盛顿尚未就其近期针对印度的建议采取行动。

印度外交部指责美国国际宗教自由委员会存在偏见。新德里多次驳斥此类批评，称其干涉印度内政。

印度驻华盛顿大使馆没有回应置评请求。

近几周，选民名册修订引发了抗议。反对派团体和学生示威者表示，此次修订影响了那些不太可能投票支持印度人民党的人。

人权专家谴责印度当局对抗议活动采取的镇压行动。

美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥上月表示，此事属于“国内政治事务”，华盛顿不会发表评论。

联合国专家和人权组织表示，莫迪先生执政期间，针对少数群体的侵害有所增加。他们指出，仇恨言论日益增多；联合国称一部基于宗教的公民身份法“具有根本歧视性”；穆斯林拥有的房产遭到拆除；反改宗立法也对信仰自由构成挑战。

民权倡导者也批评了美国境内针对穆斯林的待遇，同时指出近年来伊斯兰恐惧症有所上升，并记录了共和党人在选举活动期间不断加剧的反穆斯林言论。

MANILA, Philippines – US President Donald Trump on Wednesday, November 18, announced what he described as “the biggest trade deal” between the Philippines and the United States during the final activity of his brief state visit to Manila. Trump disclosed this in his remarks at the state luncheon in his honor in Malacañang Palace following his bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr ., but gave no details about the deal. “We’ve just consummated a trade deal, the biggest trade deal we’ve ever made by far and it’s a fair deal for both countries. We’re very happy with it. We didn’t know that was going to take place but it took place very quickly. It’s a magnificent deal for both,” Trump said. “So today, under the leadership of President Marcos and myself, I’m proud to say that we’re making the alliance between the United States and the Philippines much stronger than it’s ever been before, especially with the consummation of this deal,” he added. Marcos’ office later said both sides reached an understanding on areas of economic cooperation, but made no mention of a trade deal. Trade representatives of both countries will work closely to translate the commitments into concrete initiatives, it said in a statement. “I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different trade deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark, and, in particular, a deal that will be great for our farmers and those in the business of ‘energy,'” Trump said on Truth Social after his Philippine visit, but gave no further details. Negotiations on a trade deal between the two allies were not mentioned in any schedules released by either country. “The US offered for us to diversify our food supply and energy requirements,” said Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel Romualdez. Asked whether anything was signed, Romualdez said in a text message, “None.” Trump said in his remarks at the start of his bilateral meeting with Marcos that the US is expanding its defense cooperation with the Philippines. The Philippines and the US are treaty allies through the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty, the core of their ties, signed years after Washington recognized Manila’s independence. The treaty covers possible attacks in the South China Sea . In December 2025, the US Congress passed the Philippines Enhance Resilience Act , which authorizes allocating $500 million annually in foreign military financing to the Philippines, totaling $2.5 billion by 2030. Trump also signaled that the US wants deepened collaboration in energy security, particularly nuclear energy. He added that the US may do “something very big” in the civilian nuclear industry. “And for the Philippines to embrace American technology in its first modern nuclear project would underscore the strength of the important relationship,” he said. In February, the US announced several initiatives to help the Philippines in integrating nuclear power into its energy mix by 2032. This was two years after the enforcement of a landmark civil nuclear cooperation agreement between the two countries in 2024. (READ: A nuclear Philippines in six years? OECD’s nuclear chief isn’t convinced. ) While the Philippines and the US have been strong allies, this alliance was tested during the administration of Marcos’ predecessor, Rodrigo Duterte, who sought a pivot to China, but this foreign policy direction had since been reset under Marcos. The years that followed saw an increase in the intensity of military training exercises, as well as the frequency of joint sails in the West Philippine Sea, including near areas that China claims or de-facto controls. 菲律宾马尼拉——11月18日星期三，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在结束对马尼拉短暂国事访问的最后一项活动期间宣布，他所称为菲律宾与美国之间“最大贸易协议”的协议。特朗普是在马拉坎南宫举行的以其名义举行的国事午宴上，在与总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 举行双边会谈后透露这一消息的，但没有透露协议细节。 特朗普说：“我们刚刚完成了一项贸易协议，这是我们迄今达成过的最大贸易协议，而且对双方都是公平的协议。我们对此非常满意。我们事先不知道会达成协议，但协议推进得很快。这对双方来说都是一项极其出色的协议。” 他补充道：“因此，今天，在马科斯总统和我本人的领导下，我感到自豪地说，随着这项协议的达成，我们正在把美国与菲律宾之间的联盟关系加强到前所未有的程度。” 马科斯办公室后来表示，双方在经济合作领域达成了共识，但未提及贸易协议。办公室在一份声明中说，两国贸易代表将密切合作，把各项承诺转化为具体举措。 特朗普结束对菲律宾的访问后在Truth Social上表示：“我高兴地宣布，我们与菲律宾达成了一项全新且完全不同的贸易协议。这将是一项真正的里程碑，尤其是一项对农民以及能源行业从业者大有裨益的协议。”但他没有透露进一步细节。 两国作为盟友就贸易协议开展的谈判，并未出现在任一国家发布的任何日程安排中。 菲律宾驻美国大使何塞·曼努埃尔·罗穆亚尔德斯说：“美国提出要帮助我们实现食品供应和能源需求多元化。”当被问及是否签署了任何文件时，罗穆亚尔德斯在短信中回答：“没有。” 特朗普在与马科斯双边会谈开始时表示，美国正在扩大与菲律宾的防务合作。根据1951年《共同防御条约》，菲律宾与美国是条约盟友。该条约是两国关系的核心，签署时间是在华盛顿承认马尼拉独立多年之后。条约涵盖南海可能发生的袭击。 2025年12月，美国国会通过《菲律宾增强韧性法案》，授权每年向菲律宾拨款5亿美元的外军融资，到2030年累计将达到25亿美元。 特朗普还暗示，美国希望加强在能源安全、尤其是核能领域的合作。他补充称，美国可能在民用核工业领域采取“非常重大的行动”。 他说：“菲律宾在其首个现代核项目中采用美国技术，将凸显这一重要关系的 strength。” 2月，美国宣布多项举措，帮助菲律宾到2032年将核能纳入其能源结构。这是两国于2024年实施一项具有里程碑意义的民用核能合作协议两年后公布的。 （阅读：菲律宾六年后会拥有核能吗？OECD核能负责人并不确信。） 尽管菲律宾与美国一直是Strong盟友，但这段联盟关系在马科斯的前任罗德里戈·杜特尔特执政期间曾受到考验。杜特尔特曾寻求转向中国，但此后这一外交政策方向在马科斯任内得到重新调整。 此后的几年里，军演强度有所提升，在西菲律宾海举行联合巡航的频率也有所增加，其中包括靠近中国声称拥有或实际控制的海域。 加载相关话题 https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries said Friday a U.S. maritime delegation visited its shipyard to discuss cooperation in shipbuilding, military logistics and port infrastructure. The delegation, led by Mark D. Johnson, deputy administrator of the U.S. Maritime Administration (MARAD), toured the shipyard in Ulsan, about 360 kilometers southeast of Seoul, on Thursday. MARAD, an agency under the U.S. Department of Transportation, oversees maritime transport of military supplies during national emergencies and supports port infrastructure development. The visit came as Washington pushes to rebuild its domestic shipbuilding industry under its "Bridge Strategy," which seeks to leverage the shipbuilding expertise and production capacity of allies while expanding its own industrial base. Last month, HD Hyundai signed an agreement with U.S. engineering and construction firm Kiewit to establish a joint venture to build a shipyard in the United States. Construction is scheduled to begin next year, with full-scale operations targeted for 2029

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Unification Minister Chung Dong-young was set to meet U.S. Ambassador Michelle Steel and U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson on Friday, the ministry said. It will be Chung's first official meeting with Steel, who arrived here in late July as Washington's top envoy to Seoul. The ministry confirmed last month that it was arranging the meeting. Since her arrival, Steel has met a series of South Korean ministers, beginning with Foreign Minister Cho Hyun in early August. That she had yet to meet Chung more than two months into her tenure, however, had fueled speculation that the United States was displeased with Chung's alleged leak of classified information on North Korea. The speculation centered on Chung's remarks in March about a third uranium enrichment facility in North Korea, which the U.S. government regards as classified information. Chung has said the information was already in the public domain. Chung and Steel are widely expected to discuss ways to resume dialogue with Pyongyang as well as Seoul's push for peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula. They will meet at Chung's office in the government complex in Seoul. Chung will then travel to the inter-Korean border village of Panmunjom later in the day to meet Brunson, who also leads the United Nations Command and South Korea-U.S. Combined Forces Command. It will also be the first official meeting between the two. Brunson took command in South Korea in December 2024, and Chung became unification minister in July 2025
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 统一部长将与美国最高特使和驻韩美军司令举行首次会谈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国统一部长郑东永定于周五会见美国大使米歇尔·斯蒂尔和驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军，韩国统一部表示。这将是郑东永与斯蒂尔的首次正式会面。斯蒂尔于7月下旬抵达韩国，担任美国驻首尔最高特使。上个月，韩国统一部证实正在安排此次会面。斯蒂尔抵达后先后会见了多名韩国部长，首先是8月初会见外交部长赵显。任职两个多月仍未与郑东永会面，由此引发了外界猜测，认为美国对郑东永涉嫌泄露朝鲜机密信息感到不满。外界猜测的焦点是郑东永3月关于朝鲜第三座铀浓缩设施的言论，美国政府将相关信息视为机密。郑东永则表示，这些信息早已在公开领域流传。外界普遍预计，郑东永和斯蒂尔将讨论恢复与平壤对话的方式，以及首尔推动朝鲜半岛和平共处的努力。两人将在首尔政府办公区的统一部长办公室会面。当天稍晚，郑东永将前往朝韩边境村庄板门店会见布伦森。布伦森同时担任联合国军司令部以及韩美联合司令部司令。两人此次也将是首次正式会面。布伦森于2024年12月在韩国就职，郑东永则于2025年7月出任统一部长。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Hankook, Kumho, Nexen Tire expand European production as EU tariffs loom Korea’s three tire makers — Hankook Tire, Kumho Tire and Nexen Tire — are set to see their European profit margins come under pressure, as the European Union (EU) tightens trade barriers on tires manufactured in China as early as next month.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 随着欧盟关税逼近，韩国三大轮胎制造商——韩泰轮胎、锦湖轮胎和耐克森轮胎——在欧洲的利润空间将承压，因为欧盟最早将于下月收紧对中国制造轮胎的贸易壁垒；韩泰、锦湖和耐克森轮胎正扩大欧洲产能。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hankook, Kumho, Nexen Tire expand European production as EU tariffs loom Korea’s three tire makers — Hankook Tire, Kumho Tire and Nexen Tire — are set to see their European profit margins come under pressure, as the European Union (EU) tightens trade barriers on tires manufactured in China as early as next month. The EU is expected to finalize countervailing duties on Chinese-made tires in early December, posing an additional financial burden to Korean tire makers after the EU started imposing anti-dumping duties from July. If finalized as currently proposed, the combined tariff rate on tires made at Chinese plants and exported to Europe will rise to 28.76 percent both for Kumho Tire and Nexen Tire, and 27.5 percent for Hankook Tire. The impact will vary widely because the three companies rely on Chinese plants to different degrees for their European sales. About 50 percent of Kumho Tire’s European sales are supplied from China, compared with around 30 percent for Hankook Tire and only about 4 percent for Nexen Tire. The EU’s anti-dumping duties target tires sold in the bloc at what it considers "unfairly low" prices. The separate countervailing duties are aimed at offsetting financial advantages Chinese tire makers receive from government subsidies and protecting European producers from unfair competition. The additional tariff burden is expected to accelerate efforts by Korean tire makers to reduce their reliance on Chinese plants and shift some production closer to the European market. Hankook Tire is already expanding production at its plant in Hungary, which currently supplies less than 40 percent of its European volume. The company is ramping up additional production of truck and bus tires, with the expansion targeted for full operation by the end of the second quarter of 2027. The firm’s plant in Tennessee in the United States is also scheduled to reach full production in the first quarter of 2027, giving the company more flexibility to adjust its global production network. Kumho Tire, which has the highest exposure among the three, plans to reduce the share of China-produced tires in its European sales to 30 percent or less by next year. The company is also preparing to start operations at a new plant in Poland in the second half of 2028. Nexen Tire has taken a different approach by preemptively shifting European-bound orders away from China to its plants in the Czech Republic and Korea. The company plans to further optimize production based on customer orders, allowing it to reduce costs and limit its tariff exposure
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 中国市场敞口预计将扩大韩国轮胎企业之间的利润差距
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 随着欧盟关税大棒即将落下，韩国三大轮胎制造商——韩泰轮胎、锦湖轮胎和耐森轮胎——将扩大欧洲产能。欧盟最早将在下月收紧对中国制造轮胎的贸易壁垒，韩泰轮胎、锦湖轮胎和耐森轮胎在欧洲业务的利润率预计将因此承压。欧盟预计将在12月初敲定对中国制造轮胎征收反补贴税；在欧盟自7月起征收反倾销税之后，这将为韩国轮胎制造商带来额外财务负担。如果按目前的提议最终敲定，中国工厂生产并出口至欧洲的轮胎，其综合关税率对锦湖轮胎和耐森轮胎将升至28.76%，对韩泰轮胎则升至27.5%。由于三家公司对中国工厂的依赖程度不同，所受影响也将大相径庭。锦湖轮胎欧洲销售中约50%由中国工厂供货，韩泰轮胎约为30%，耐森轮胎则仅约4%。欧盟征收反倾销税，针对的是其认为以“不公平低价”在欧盟市场销售的轮胎。另行征收的反补贴税旨在抵消中国轮胎制造商从政府补贴中获得的财务优势，并保护欧洲生产商免受不公平竞争。额外关税负担预计将促使韩国轮胎制造商加快减少对中国工厂的依赖，并将部分生产转移到更接近欧洲市场的地区。韩泰轮胎已在扩大其匈牙利工厂的产能，目前该工厂供应的产量不足其欧洲销量的40%。公司正在增产卡车轮胎和客车轮胎，扩产目标是在2027年第二季度末全面投产。该公司位于美国田纳西州的工厂也计划于2027年第一季度全面投产，使公司能够更灵活地调整全球生产网络。三家中对欧洲业务受中国产轮胎影响依赖度最高的锦湖轮胎，计划到明年将中国制造轮胎在其欧洲销售中的占比降至30%或以下。公司还在准备于2028年下半年启动波兰新工厂的运营。耐森轮胎采取了不同做法，提前将原本从中国运往欧洲的订单转移至捷克和韩国的工厂。公司计划根据客户订单进一步优化生产，从而降低成本并限制关税带来的影响

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: NEW YORK — South Korean conglomerate Base Group is preparing to invest $150 million in a struggling military-robot maker backed by U.S. President Donald Trump's son Eric, internal company emails show, deepening the firm’s ties to the Trump family that have already drawn congressional scrutiny.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 纽约——公司内部邮件显示，韩国企业集团Base Group正准备向一家陷入困境的军事机器人制造商投资1.5亿美元。该制造商得到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普之子埃里克的支持，由此加深了该公司与特朗普家族的联系，而这种联系已经受到国会审查。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — South Korean conglomerate Base Group is preparing to invest $150 million in a struggling military-robot maker backed by U.S. President Donald Trump's son Eric, internal company emails show, deepening the firm’s ties to the Trump family that have already drawn congressional scrutiny. Foundation Future Industries, which makes gun-carrying “Terminator”-style robot soldiers and employs Eric Trump as chief strategy adviser, stopped paying employees in recent weeks and is pinning its future on Base Group’s funding, according to CEO Sankaet Pathak's emails to employees seen by Reuters. “My read, given where Base is, this is a timing issue, not an existential one for the company,” Pathak wrote in a November 8 email, referring to the payroll issues. A Base Group spokesperson confirmed the company was considering an investment in Foundation, "recognizing the long-term value and growth potential of humanoid robotics,” but did not respond to further questions. Base Group’s planned investment has not previously been reported. CNBC first reported that Foundation had stopped paying its employees. Any investment by Seoul-based Base could intensify scrutiny of Base Group’s financial interests in companies tied to the Trump family, which has expanded into military and national security-focused ventures vying for Pentagon contracts in the past two years. In an August open letter, Democratic senators demanded that Base explain its relationship with the Trump family, questioning whether a $2 million payment the conglomerate made to the Trump Organization in 2025 was connected to its efforts to win relief from U.S. aluminum tariffs. The senators said any such quid pro quo would be an “egregious example of Trump Administration corruption." Base did not address questions about the congressional scrutiny in its statement to Reuters. Foundation and Pathak did not respond to requests for comment. Spokespeople for the Trump Organization and Eric Trump did not respond to requests for comment. Base Group has been working with the Trump Organization since at least 2017, when one of its subsidiaries secured an agreement to import wine from Trump Winery, the family's vineyard business. In February, the company hosted Eric Trump in Seoul for a summit focused on potential business partnerships between the United States and South Korea, according to local media reports. Then, in August, the Trump Organization announced it was building a golf course in South Korea in partnership with Base. Foundation has emerged as one of the Trump family’s highest-profile bets on defense technology. In April, Eric Trump appeared on Fox News with Pathak and said he got involved in the company to help the U.S. beat China in humanoids. “That’s exactly what Sankaet is doing, and he’s doing a phenomenal job,” Eric Trump said. Pathak, a Silicon Valley founder who previously led fintech startup Synapse, which filed for bankruptcy in April 2024, launched Foundation months later and has since raised $11 million from investors including Tribe Capital, Defined and Gaingels, according to Pitchbook. In his emails to employees, Pathak emphasized Base’s belief in Foundation’s future. Base Chairman Kim Seong-jip “sees humanoid robotics as the biggest unlock for the labor constraints across their businesses. He sees Foundation as the company doing it right,” Pathak said. “This is a long-term partnership and not just a financing event,” he wrote in a November 12 email. Pathak said Base would also set up a joint venture with Foundation to provide aluminum for the robots and lithium for their batteries as part of its investment. On November 14, CNBC reported that Foundation had stopped paying employees and that Pathak had taken a $4.6 million loan from the company to purchase a home in California
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 韩国一家企业计划向埃里克·特朗普支持的机器人制造商提供1.5亿美元纾困资金
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约——公司内部邮件显示，韩国 conglomerate Base Group 正准备向一家陷入困境的军用机器人制造商投资1.5亿美元；这家制造商得到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普之子埃里克的支持。由此，该公司与特朗普家族的深化关系将受到国会进一步审查，而这种关系此前已引发国会议员关注。据首席执行官桑凯特·帕萨克发送给员工的邮件（路透社看到），制造携枪“终结者”式机器人士兵并聘请埃里克·特朗普担任首席战略顾问的 Foundation Future Industries，近几周已停止支付员工薪酬，并把未来押注在 Base Group 的资金上。帕萨克在11月8日的一封邮件中谈及薪资问题并写道：“根据 Base 目前的状况，我的判断是这只是时间安排问题，并非公司面临生存危机。”Base Group 发言人确认公司正考虑投资 Foundation，称其“认可人形机器人的长期价值和增长潜力”，但没有回答进一步的问题。Base Group 计划中的投资此前未曾见诸报道。CNBC 率先报道 Foundation 已停止向员工支付薪酬。总部位于首尔的 Base 若进行投资，可能加剧对 Base Group 与特朗普家族关联企业之经济利益的审查。过去两年，特朗普家族已将业务扩展至聚焦军事和国家安全的领域，竞逐五角大楼合同。8月，民主党参议员在公开信中要求 Base 说明其与特朗普家族的关系，并质疑该 conglomerate 于2025年向 Trump Organization 支付的200万美元是否与其争取美国铝关税豁免的努力有关。参议员称，任何此类利益交换都将是“特朗普政府腐败的恶劣例证”。Base 在给路透社的声明中未回应有关国会审查的问题。Foundation 和帕萨克没有回应置评请求。Trump Organization 和埃里克·特朗普通话言人没有回应置评请求。Base Group 至少从2017年起便与 Trump Organization 合作，当时其一家子公司达成协议，从特朗普家族经营的葡萄园业务 Trump Winery 进口葡萄酒。据当地媒体报道，今年2月，该公司在首尔主办了一场峰会，埃里克·特朗普出席，峰会重点讨论美国与韩国之间潜在的商业合作机会。随后，Trump Organization 在8月宣布正与 Base 合作在韩国建设一座高尔夫球场。Foundation 已成为特朗普家族在国防技术领域最受关注的投资项目之一。4月，埃里克·特朗普与帕萨克一同亮相福克斯新闻，并表示他参与该公司是为了帮助美国在人形机器人领域击败中国。“桑凯特正在做的正是这件事，而且做得非常出色。”埃里克·特朗说道。据 Pitchbook，帕萨克是一名硅谷创始人，曾领导金融科技初创公司 Synapse；该公司于2024年4月申请破产。数月后，他创办了 Foundation，此后已从 Tribe Capital、Defined 和 Gaingels 等投资者处筹集1100万美元。帕萨克在发给员工的邮件中强调 Base 对 Foundation 未来的信心。帕萨克称，Base 董事长金成植“认为人形机器人是突破其各项业务劳动力限制的最大机遇。他看好 Foundation，因为该公司做事的方式是对的”。他在11月12日的一封邮件中写道：“这是一项长期伙伴关系，而不仅仅是一次融资。”帕萨克表示，作为投资的一部分，Base 还将与 Foundation 设立一家合资企业，为机器人供应铝，并为电池供应锂。11月14日，CNBC 报道称 Foundation 已停止向员工支付薪酬，帕萨克还从该公司获得了460万美元贷款，用于在加利福尼亚州购买住宅

Rather, he argues, it is about demonstrating Xi's ability to bring the American and Russian leaders together to discuss major geopolitical issues. He stressed the need for specialised training and sustained capacity development for officers involved in maritime security, cargo examination and enforcement operations. The Customs chief also highlighted the introduction of Customs Mutual Assistance Agreements (CMA) as a framework for improving cooperation, information exchange and operational collaboration between customs administrations. He called for stronger inter-agency collaboration, improved technical capabilities and continuous professional development to address emerging maritime security threats. Ortsen said the engagement provided an opportunity for Nigerian and US representatives, alongside other relevant agencies, to exchange views on maritime security challenges and strengthen institutional cooperation. He reaffirmed the commitment of the Comptroller-General of Customs, Bashir Adewale Adeniyi, to equipping officers with the knowledge, technical skills and operational intelligence required to identify goods that could pose security risks. As part of the programme, participants toured relevant maritime and port facilities to gain practical insights into port operations, existing security arrangements and the responsibilities of different stakeholders in the maritime environment. https://leadership.ng/federal-government.summary: The ministry said the team agreed to implement as much capital spending as possible in 2026, with outstanding balances rolled into 2027. The ministry said the EMT identified food security and price stability as a key priority under a 90-day action plan approved by the National Economic Council and endorsed by the Federal Executive Council.
https://leadership.ng/federal-government.summary_zh: 该部表示，团队同意在2026年尽可能多地实施资本支出，未支出的余额将结转至2027年。该部表示，在国家经济委员会批准并获联邦执行委员会认可的90天行动计划下，紧急经济行动小组将粮食安全和价格稳定确定为一项重点优先事项。
https://leadership.ng/federal-government.body: The plan emerged from a meeting of the Economic Management Team (EMT) in Abuja on Wednesday, chaired by the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, Taiwo Oyedele. The ministry said the team agreed to implement as much capital spending as possible in 2026, with outstanding balances rolled into 2027. The EMT also reviewed progress on the 2027 finance bill, which the ministry said would update Nigeria’s tax laws and add to the ongoing tax reform. It said the aim is to ease doing business, lower borrowing costs and channel more financial-sector liquidity into the real economy. The ministry said the EMT reported that real GDP grew by 4.43 per cent in the second quarter of 2026, while headline and core inflation continued to slow. It put October’s inflation reading at 14.06 per cent and described it as a six-year low. It stated that external reserves stood at about $55 billion and that the exchange rate was stable and appreciating. According to the ministry, Moody’s and Fitch have both revised Nigeria’s sovereign credit outlook from stable to positive in 2026. It noted that this followed S&P Global’s upgrade of the country’s rating to ‘B’ from ‘B-‘ in May. The ministry said the team agreed that discussions on the economy and credit ratings should be grounded in data and evidence. It disclosed that it is working to publish finalised financial and economic information on its website before the end of the year. The ministry said the EMT identified food security and price stability as a key priority under a 90-day action plan approved by the National Economic Council and endorsed by the Federal Executive Council. It said the team discussed measures to stabilise prices of staples such as cassava, yams, maize and rice. These, it explained, include strengthening farm-input delivery, reducing post-harvest losses and improving the targeting of agricultural support. The ministry said the EMT reviewed the national gas plan and the power sector’s 90-day action plan, which it noted targets consistent grid distribution of about 5,500 megawatts in the near term. It added that work would continue on transmission capacity, metering, and the protection of critical electricity infrastructure from vandalism and theft. The ministry said the EMT also reviewed the draft National Development Plan 2026–2036, which it said is built around seven pillars: macroeconomic stability, energy, industrialisation, infrastructure, governance, security and human capital development. It said members were asked to carry out further review, with feedback to be incorporated ahead of the plan’s launch. The ministry said the team received updates on the creative economy and tourism sector, including progress on a creative economy bill before the National Assembly and plans for a Presidential Council on Tourism, approved by the Federal Executive Council. It added that the team also received a presentation on Nigeria’s new national digital addressing system. According to the ministry, those in attendance were the Minister of Marine and Blue Economy, Adegboyega Oyetola; Minister of Power, Joseph Tegbe; Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Dr. Bosun Tijani; Minister of Regional Development, Abubakar Momoh; Minister of Labour and Employment, Muhammadu Maigari Dingyadi; and Minister of Art, Culture, Tourism and the Creative Economy, Hannatu Musa Musawa. Others named were the Minister of State, Petroleum Resources (Gas), Dr. Ekperikpe Ekpo; Minister of State for Budget, Dr. Doris Uzoka-Anite; and the Central Bank of Nigeria’s Deputy Governor (Economic Policy), Philip Ikeazor. The ministry said Special Adviser to the President, Dr. Tope Fasua, the Permanent Secretaries of Finance and Transportation, and the Postmaster General, Engr. Omotola Odeyemi, also attended. https://leadership.ng/federal-government.body_zh: 该计划是在周三于阿布贾举行的经济管理小组（EMT）会议上提出的，会议由财政部长兼经济协调部长 Taiwo Oyedele 主持。财政部表示，小组同意在2026年尽可能扩大资本支出，并将未完成的余额结转至2027年。经济管理小组还审查了2027年财政法案的进展。财政部表示，该法案将更新尼日利亚税收法律，并补充正在推进的税收改革。财政部称，改革旨在便利经营、降低借贷成本，并将更多金融体系流动性引导至实体经济。财政部表示，经济管理小组报告称，2026年第二季度尼日利亚实际国内生产总值增长4.43%，总体通胀率和核心通胀率继续放缓。财政部将10月通胀率列为14.06%，并称其处于六年来的低点。财政部表示，尼日利亚外汇储备约为550亿美元，汇率保持稳定并升值。财政部指出，穆迪和惠誉均已在2026年将尼日利亚主权信用展望从“稳定”调整为“积极”。财政部表示，此前标普全球已于5月将该国评级从“B-”上调至“B”。财政部称，经济管理小组同意，有关经济状况和信用评级的讨论应以数据和证据为依据。财政部透露，正在推进相关工作，以便在年底前将其网站上的最终财务和经济信息公布。财政部表示，经济管理小组将粮食安全和价格稳定列为90天行动计划的重点，该计划已获国家经济委员会批准，并得到联邦执行委员会认可。财政部称，小组讨论了稳定木薯、山药、玉米和大米等主食价格的措施。财政部解释，这些措施包括加强农业投入品供应、减少收获后损失，以及改善农业支持的定向发放。财政部表示，经济管理小组审查了国家天然气计划以及电力行业的90天行动计划，并指出该计划的目标是在近期实现约5,500兆瓦的稳定电网供电。财政部补充称，将继续推进输电能力、计量以及保护关键电力基础设施免遭破坏和盗窃的工作。财政部表示，经济管理小组还审查了《2026—2036年国家发展计划》草案，称其围绕七大支柱构建：宏观经济稳定、能源、工业化、基础设施、治理、安全以及人力资本开发。财政部表示，与会成员被要求进一步审查该草案，并在计划发布前纳入反馈意见。财政部表示，小组听取了创意经济和旅游业的最新情况，包括提交国民议会审议的创意经济法案进展，以及设立总统旅游委员会的计划，该计划已获联邦执行委员会批准。财政部补充称，小组还听取了关于尼日利亚新国家数字地址系统的介绍。财政部称，出席人员包括海洋与蓝色经济部长 Adegboyega Oyetola；电力部长 Joseph Tegbe；通信、创新与数字经济部长 Bosun Tijani 博士；区域发展部长 Abubakar Momoh；劳工与就业部长 Muhammadu Maigari Dingyadi；艺术、文化、旅游与创意经济部长 Hannatu Musa Musawa。其他出席者包括国家元首（石油资源〔天然气〕）事务部长 Ekperikpe Ekpo 博士；预算国务部长 Doris Uzoka-Anite 博士；以及尼日利亚中央银行副行长（经济政策）Philip Ikeazor。财政部表示，总统特别顾问 Tope Fasua 博士、财政部和交通部常务秘书，以及邮政总监 Omotola Odeyemi 工程师也出席了会议。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角将直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: U.S. President Donald Trump floated the prospect of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his trip to China this week, but experts said talks are unlikely in the near term and warned that any eventual deal with Pyongyang could leave South Korea facing new security risks. Before departing for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, Trump told reporters, “We may meet with Kim Jong-un also, so that’ll be good. We have a chance to accomplish a lot.” Asked about Kim, he added, “He may come; I don’t know. That’s up to (Chinese) President Xi (Jinping).” On the agenda for a planned three-way summit with Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin, Trump said, “We are going to talk about denuclearization. Tough subject because it is very hard for any of us to say we will get rid of our nukes.” His remarks came amid growing doubts that a Trump-Kim meeting would take place on the sidelines of the APEC summit. A senior U.S. official reportedly told reporters Sunday, “There are no plans at all for engagement with North Korea.” A Cheong Wa Dae official also downplayed the prospect of a summit on Thursday, saying, “North Korea is unlikely to attend a multilateral gathering. While it is difficult to be certain, I doubt a Trump-Kim summit will take place.” South Korean authorities have taken a cautious approach, maintaining that there are no signs of official preparations for a summit while keeping the door open. “Judging by the specific circumstances, the possibility is generally low,” a foreign ministry official said. “However, we cannot rule it out since Trump made such remarks again and we don’t know the background behind them.” A unification ministry official said there was “no information” on any travel by Kim to China, but noted he could reach the country by air or by crossing the border overland. “We haven’t ruled out the possibility of Kim visiting China. We should wait and see,” the official said. Experts said Trump-Kim talks remain possible, though not at APEC, given the lack of signs of working-level exchanges between Pyongyang and Washington. “I think there is a possibility, but not in the immediate future. A meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit seems particularly unlikely,” said Park Won-gon, a professor of North Korean studies at Ewha Womans University, adding that Kim may prefer a bottom-up approach, with working-level negotiations preceding a leaders’ summit, to avoid a repeat of the Hanoi summit in 2019. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University’s Institute for Far Eastern Studies, sees no signs of the preliminary contact and coordination that normally precede a summit with Pyongyang. “It takes several times more effort to get Kim to make a move and there are no signs of such preparations now,” Lim said. “From Kim’s perspective, a meeting would be an opportunity to secure major objectives, such as recognition as a nuclear weapons state or an easing of what North Korea calls hostile policies toward it. These are not easy issues.” He added that Kim currently has nothing to gain from a meeting with Trump. “There would first need to be back-and-forth exchanges, at least at the working level, to coordinate the agenda," he said. "North Korea is closely coordinating various issues with China and Russia and discussing how to develop those relationships, but it is not doing the same with the U.S." They also said formal recognition of North Korea as a nuclear state would be difficult for Trump to pursue, but warned that negotiations could still drift in a direction unfavorable to South Korea. Park noted the issue would be complicated. “Since North Korea refuses to engage in denuclearization talks at all, negotiations could shift toward nuclear arms control, potentially leading to de facto recognition of its nuclear status. But it would be difficult for either the U.S. or China to recognize North Korea as a de facto nuclear weapons state, as doing so would undermine their own nuclear monopoly,” he said. The greater risk for Seoul, Park said, would be a deal in which Washington eases some sanctions in exchange for a halt to long-range missile development with Pyongyang retaining a short-range arsenal. “If Trump achieves that, he could declare victory, saying he has made the U.S. mainland safe, and use that narrative for domestic political purposes," Park said. "That would pose a security challenge for South Korea.” Whang Taehee, a professor of political science and international studies at Yonsei University, also expressed concern. “Trump acknowledges that North Korea possesses nuclear weapons to ensure the regime’s survival,” he said during a YTN broadcast. "But the problem is that recognizing its nuclear status would undermine the Nuclear Nonproliferation Treaty regime and shift negotiations toward nuclear arms control, putting South Korea at a significant disadvantage." However, Lim said the incoming Democratic-controlled U.S. Congress could limit Trump’s room to maneuver. “Trump cannot do this on his authority alone. Congressional approval is necessary. With the makeup of Congress changing completely on Jan. 3, 2027, there will be very little Trump can do,” Lim said. Park stressed that Seoul’s best safeguard is closer coordination with Washington. “Our only option is to strengthen cooperation between South Korea and the United States. Whether it is a summit among the U.S., China and Russia or some other arrangement, there is a risk that South Korea could be sidelined,” Park said. “To avoid that, Seoul and Washington need close communication and cooperation. Relations between the two countries are strained on several fronts at the moment, so it is important to quickly readjust the relationship and get it back on track.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 特朗普试探在中国举行朝美峰会，但专家看不到任何准备迹象
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本周赴中国访问期间提出，本周访华期间他可能与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面，但专家表示近期会谈的可能性不大，并警告说，与平壤最终达成的任何协议都可能使韩国面临新的安全风险。在启程前往中国深圳出席亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会之前，特朗普对记者说：“我们也可能与金正恩会面，那样挺好。我们有机会取得很多成果。”被问及金正恩时，他补充说：“他可能会来；我不知道，这要看（中国）习近平主席的安排。”特朗普说，在与习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京计划举行的三方峰会议程中，“我们将讨论无核化。这个议题很棘手，因为我们要让任何一方表态放弃核武器都非常困难。”他的这番讲话正值外界对特朗普与金正恩是否会在APEC峰会期间会面的疑虑日益加深之际。据报道，一名美国高级官员周日对记者表示：“目前完全没有与朝鲜接触的计划。”青瓦台一名官员周四也淡化了举行峰会的可能性，称：“朝鲜不太可能参加多边会议。虽然难以确定，但我怀疑特朗普与金正恩的峰会不会举行。”韩国当局采取谨慎态度，坚持表示没有任何官方筹备峰会的迹象，同时仍为峰会留有余地。一名外 ministry官员表示：“从具体情况判断，可能性总体较低。”“不过，既然特朗普又说了这样的话，我们也不知道他背后的考量，因此不能排除。”统一 ministry一名官员表示，关于金正恩访华“没有任何信息”，但指出他可以乘飞机或经陆路跨境抵达中国。该官员说：“我们尚未排除金正恩访华的可能性。我们应该观望。”专家表示，在缺乏平壤与华盛顿之间工作层接触迹象的情况下，特朗普与金正恩的会谈仍然有可能，只是不会在APEC期间举行。梨花女子大学朝鲜研究教授朴元健说：“我认为存在可能性，但不是近期。在APEC峰会期间会面似乎尤其不太可能。”他补充说，金正恩可能更倾向于自下而上的做法，即先进行工作层谈判，再举行领导人峰会，以避免重演2019年河内峰会的情形。庆南大学远东研究所教授林曰哲认为，目前看不到通常在平壤峰会之前进行的前期接触与协调的迹象。林说：“要促使金正恩采取行动，需要付出数倍的努力，而目前没有任何这类准备的迹象。”“从金正恩的角度看，会面将是一个实现重大目标的机会，例如获得承认其为核武器国家，或缓解朝鲜所称的针对它的敌视政策。这些都不是容易解决的问题。”他补充说，金正恩目前从与特朗普会面中得不到任何好处。他说：“首先需要双方来回交换意见，至少在工作层层面协调议程。朝鲜正在就多项议题与中国和俄罗斯密切协调，讨论如何发展这些关系，但它对美国并没有这样做。”他们还表示，正式承认朝鲜为核国家对特朗普而言将难以推行，但警告谈判仍可能朝对韩国不利的方向漂移。朴指出，这一议题将十分复杂。他说：“由于朝鲜完全拒绝参与无核化谈判，谈判可能转向核军备控制，从而有可能导致事实上的核地位承认。但无论是美国还是中国，都很难承认朝鲜为事实上的核武器国家，因为这样做会破坏自身的核垄断。”朴说，对首尔而言更大的风险，是一种华盛顿放松部分制裁、以换取朝鲜停止发展远程导弹、同时平壤保留短程导弹库的协议。朴说：“如果特朗普实现了这一点，他可以宣布胜利，称自己保障了美国本土的安全，并把这一说法用于国内政治目的。那将给韩国带来安全挑战。”延世大学政治学与国际研究教授黄太熙也表达了担忧。他说，在YTN播出的节目中：“特朗普承认朝鲜拥有核武器，以确保政权生存。”“但问题在于，承认其核地位会削弱《不扩散核武器条约》体系，并使谈判转向核军备控制，使韩国处于非常不利的位置。”不过林表示，即将上任的由民主党掌控的美国国会会限制特朗普的回旋空间。林说：“特朗普无法凭一己之力做成这件事，必须获得国会批准。随着国会构成在2027年1月3日完全改变，特朗普能做的事情将非常有限。”朴强调，首尔最好的保障是与华盛顿加强协调。朴说：“我们唯一的选择是加强韩美合作。无论是美国、中国和俄罗斯之间的峰会，还是其他某种安排，韩国都有被边缘化的风险。”“为避免这种情况，首尔和华盛顿需要密切沟通与合作。目前两国关系在多个方面较为紧张，因此迅速重新调整双边关系、使其重回正轨十分重要。”

https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-tory-.body: LONDON — Kemi Badenoch called Donald Trump’s trilateral meeting in Shenzhen “disturbing” — as she placed significant distance between the U.K.’s opposition Conservatives and the U.S president. “It’s basically an administration on its way out — we should be looking to the future,” the Tory leader told the BBC Thursday morning when pressed on Trump’s White House. The U.S. president is holding three-way talks with his “ friend ” Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese premier Xi Jinping. Trump has defended his decision to engage directly with two leaders whose countries are often at odds with Washington, saying he has “a special responsibility to maintain open, respectful and productive dialogue on issues impacting not just our people, but the entire planet.” “Disturbing is how I would describe it,” Badenoch told the Today program when pressed on the summit. “There are three world leaders who look like they’re trying to carve up the world between them.” She argued that the three leaders are trying to forge a tripolar world where the Chinese president commands Asia, the American the western hemisphere, and the Russian gets Europe. “That is very concerning, especially seeing Donald Trump call president Putin his friend. Russia is not America’s friend,” Badenoch added. It’s another notable break by a British right-wing leader with the U.S. commander-in-chief. Badenoch praised Trump after his return the White House, and even looked enviously at initiatives like DOGE and ICE . But like Nigel Farage , the leader of her right-wing rivals in the Reform UK party, Badenoch has been distancing the Conservatives from Trump as the effects of his foreign policy become apparent in the U.K. Her latest comments come after Trump’s Republicans took a major hit in the U.S. mid-terms. Badenoch called for Britain to strengthen partnerships “with all our allies,” including in the U.S., Canada and Europe — a clear tilt beyond Trump
https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-tory-.title_zh: 英国保守党党首巴德诺克批评特朗普、普京和习近平的三边互动“令人不安”
https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-tory-.body_zh: 伦敦——凯米·巴德诺奇称唐纳德·特朗普在深圳举行的三方会议“令人不安”，并明确划清了英国反对党保守党与美国总统之间的距离。周四上午，BBC记者追问特朗普入主白宫一事时，这位保守党领袖表示：“这基本上是一个即将届满的政府——我们应当着眼未来。”美国总统正与其“朋友”俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国总理习近平举行三方会谈。特朗普为直接与这两位领导人接触辩护说，他们所在的国家经常与华盛顿存在分歧，但他“肩负着特别责任，应就不仅影响本国人民、而且影响整个地球的问题维持开放、尊重且富有成效的对话”。巴德诺奇在《今日》节目中被追问此次峰会时表示：“我会把它形容为令人不安。这三位世界领导人看起来像是企图在彼此之间瓜分世界。”她认为，这三位领导人正试图塑造一个三极世界：中国总统掌控亚洲，美国总统掌控西半球，俄罗斯则获得欧洲。巴德诺奇补充道：“这非常令人担忧，尤其是看到唐纳德·特朗普称普京总统为朋友。俄罗斯不是美国的朋友。”这是又一位英国右翼领袖与美国最高统帅公开拉开距离。特朗普重返白宫后，巴德诺奇曾对他表示赞赏，甚至对DOGE和ICE等举措心生羡慕。然而，与英国改革党leader奈杰尔·法拉奇一样，随着特朗普外交政策的影响在英国日益显现，巴德诺奇一直在推动保守党与特朗普保持距离。巴德诺奇最新表态之际，特朗普所属的共和党刚刚在美国中期选举中遭遇重大挫败。巴德诺奇呼吁英国加强“与所有盟友”的伙伴关系，包括美国、加拿大和欧洲——这清楚表明其立场已超越特朗普……
